page_data_script:
page_num = frappe.form_dict.get("page", 1)
page_length = frappe.form_dict.get("page_length", 8)  # Matches standard grid layout length
search = frappe.form_dict.get("search", None)
category = frappe.form_dict.get("category", None)

# Fetch from API
res = frappe.call('hopkins.api.get_products', page=page_num, page_length=page_length, search=search, category=category)

# Set products list for repeater block
data.products = res.get("products", [])

# Store pagination metadata in page_data (accessible client-side via window.page_data)
csrf = frappe.session.csrf_token
data.page_data = {
  "csrf": csrf,
  "current_page": int(page_num),
  "total_pages": int(res.get("total_pages", 1)),
  "total_products": int(res.get("total_products", 0)),
  "page_length": int(page_length)
}
